story_description: As a user creating a session with a specific provider, I want the system to automatically select and configure the correct CLI adapter so that my prompts are routed to the appropriate AI engine.
task_description: Add getAdapter(for:) method to EngineManager that routes session.engineType to the correct EngineAdapter instance with appropriate CLI flags.
atom_description: Implement the core routing logic in EngineManager that takes a Session and returns the appropriate EngineAdapter based on session.engineType, ensuring adapters are lazily registered and available before use.
problem_statement: EngineManager currently has a dictionary of adapters keyed by EngineType, but there is no method to get an adapter for a given Session. The orchestrator and UI need a single entry point that accepts a Session and returns the properly configured adapter for that session's provider.
scope_in: Add getAdapter(for session: Session) -> EngineAdapter? method to EngineManager
Validate adapter is registered before returning
Log warning if requested adapter type is not registered
Return nil with error context if adapter unavailable
Add convenience method getAdapter(for type: EngineType) -> EngineAdapter? for direct type lookup
scope_out: CLI flag mapping for specific models (deferred to per-adapter configuration)
Provider authentication flow (handled by each adapter's validateInstallation)
Session persistence changes (session already has engineType field)
UI for adapter selection (already exists in NewSessionModal)
assumptions: Session struct has engineType: EngineType field (verified in Models.swift:48)
EngineManager has adapters dictionary keyed by EngineType (verified in EngineAdapter.swift:117)
All three adapters (ClaudeCodeAdapter, GeminiCliAdapter, CodexCliAdapter) exist (verified via Glob)
Adapters are registered at app startup before any session is created
constraints: Must be thread-safe since EngineManager is @MainActor annotated
Must return (any EngineAdapter)? to handle unregistered adapter gracefully
Must not require Session mutation (read-only access to engineType)
Must work with existing register(adapter:) and validateAll() methods
functional_requirements: FR1: EngineManager.getAdapter(for:) accepts Session and returns matching EngineAdapter or nil
FR2: If adapter for session.engineType is not registered, method returns nil
FR3: Debug logging emits warning when adapter is not found for requested type
FR4: Method is synchronous since adapter lookup is dictionary-based O(1) operation
FR5: Existing adapter(for type:) method is preserved for backward compatibility
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Adapter lookup must complete in under 1 microsecond (simple dictionary access)
NFR2: No memory allocation on hot path (return existing adapter reference)
implementation_steps: Step 1: Open Blaze/Sources/Engine/EngineAdapter.swift and locate EngineManager class
Step 2: Add getAdapter(for session: Session) -> (any EngineAdapter)? method after existing adapter(for type:) method
Step 3: Implement method body: lookup adapters[session.engineType] and return result
Step 4: Add os.Logger instance to EngineManager for warning logs
Step 5: Add warning log if adapters[session.engineType] returns nil
Step 6: Write unit test in Tests/Engine/EngineManagerTests.swift for getAdapter routing
Step 7: Verify existing tests still pass with swift test
data_model_changes: No schema changes required - Session.engineType already exists
api_contracts: EngineManager.getAdapter(for session: Session) -> (any EngineAdapter)? - returns adapter for session's engine type
EngineManager.adapter(for type: EngineType) -> (any EngineAdapter)? - existing method preserved
event_contracts: No new events - adapter lookup is synchronous and does not emit events
ui_states: No UI changes - this is backend routing logic
ui_interactions: No UI changes - this is backend routing logic
ui_copy: No UI changes - this is backend routing logic
edge_cases: EC1: Session has engineType but no adapter registered - return nil with warning log
EC2: Session is created before adapters are registered at startup - return nil (caller must handle)
EC3: Multiple rapid calls with same session - return same adapter instance (stateless lookup)
EC4: Adapter previously registered but later removed - return nil (dictionary key removed)
failure_modes: FM1: Adapter not registered - return nil, log warning, caller shows user-facing error about missing CLI
FM2: EngineType enum gains new case not in adapters dict - return nil, log warning with unknown type
rollback_plan: Remove the getAdapter(for session:) method from EngineManager. The existing adapter(for type:) method provides equivalent functionality. No data migration needed.
